keyRules: In the open category, the maximum height is 120 m, measured as the distance to the closest point of the Earth's surface — not simply straight down, so near a slope the ground beside you can also count. Within 50 m of a tall artificial obstacle (over 105 m), the entity responsible for that obstacle may request authorization to fly up to 15 m above the obstacle's height.

Mandatory, free A1/A3 online training via Eurocontrol's LearningZone platform (FR/DE/EN/LB, 3-month renewable access); certificate valid for 5 years. The minimum age to operate an unmanned aircraft in the "open" category is 14 in Luxembourg (art. 2 of the Grand Ducal Regulation of 22 December 2025); a younger minor flies under the supervision of a person over 16 holding the required qualifications. The OPEN A2 exam is taken at the DAC premises and costs 45 €.
Mandatory liability insurance (policy number required at check-in)
The CTR for Luxembourg-Findel Airport covers a significant portion of the country

In the open category, keep the drone within your own direct line of sight, with the naked eye (corrective glasses/lenses allowed; binoculars or a screen do not count) — or be assisted by an observer, with clear and effective communication between you at all times, so that together you monitor the airspace and avoid collisions. "Follow-me" mode is a separate exception, allowed up to 50 m from the remote pilot.
Do not fly over assemblies of people. Rules for uninvolved persons depend on subcategory, class mark and operating conditions; check the official matrix.
Comply with the Luxembourg-Findel CTR and the UAS geographic zones published on Geoportail.lu — there is no longer a flat 5-km buffer zone following the EASA harmonization

Night flying is allowed in the Open category in Luxembourg, subject to the basic EASA requirements. However, some geographic zones — particularly around Findel — impose conditions or a specific night-time authorization: check the conditions for each zone at g-o.lu/uas.
Grand Ducal Palace, correctional facilities, and military zones: prior authorization required — local stadiums and airfields (Useldange, Noertrange): flying prohibited.
importantNotes: Mandatory insurance; policy number required at check-in
The CTR for Luxembourg-Findel Airport covers a large part of this small country

The new national framework — the Law of 19 December 2025 and the Grand Ducal Regulation of 22 December 2025 on unmanned aircraft — supplements the European regulations and introduces criminal penalties for non-compliance with registration, insurance and zone obligations. Fees have applied since 14 January 2026: 10 € for registration or its renewal, 30 € for an STS declaration, 45 € for the OPEN A2 exam.
The GDPR applies when capturing identifiable images

Warning (DAC): the Geozones provided by UAS manufacturers do not necessarily cover all restricted zones in Luxembourg, and there is NO automatic transfer of information between the UAS manufacturer and the Geoportail. Only the UAS geographic zones shown on g-o.lu/uas are legally applicable — your remote controller's geo-restriction is not enough.
